prompt:
Create ONE production seamless MATERIAL TILE ATLAS for a top-down 2D RPG terrain editor. This is NOT a landscape and NOT sprites of whole mountains. EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows square atlas, 1024x1024, 16 equally sized 256x256 cells touching with NO gutters, labels, border lines, padding or text. Every cell is a completely opaque FULL SQUARE material sample, filling every pixel, that can be repeated as 32x32 game turfs after reduction. Coarse deliberate pixel clusters, like detailed RPG Maker terrain, clean readable shapes at 32px, NOT fine photographic noise. Consistent diffuse overhead light. Brown sandstone palette, blue-grey arctic palette, mossy grey forest palette. No buildings, stairs, whole mountains, checkerboard or transparent pixels.
The 16 cells, left to right then next row:
Row1: (1) flat warm golden sandstone plateau ground, irregular erosion fissures seen from directly above; (2) warm darker ochre vertical sandstone cliff face with broad horizontal strata and vertical fractures, cropped material filling all edges, no ledge/ground/sky; (3) flat muted pale ochre sand with fine shallow wind ripples, no dune silhouette; (4) compact sand and scattered tiny angular sandstone gravel, natural walking slope material, no steps.
Row2: (5) flat cold off-white snow surface subtle blue shadows; (6) blue-grey vertical glacial rock wall material with diagonal cracks and a few snow-packed crevices, no sky or horizon; (7) pale bluish ice surface with delicate fractures, viewed from above; (8) compact blue-grey gravel and scattered snow, natural walking slope material.
Row3: (9) grey rough vertical forest cliff rock material with moss in fissures, no plants protruding; (10) flat green moss over grey stone surface viewed from above; (11) straight waterfall curtain, white and pale cyan vertical water streaks, runs continuously top to bottom and side to side filling whole cell, no scenery; (12) white splash foam over teal water viewed from above, full cell.
Row4: (13) dim brown sandy cave ground seen directly overhead with scattered small pebbles; (14) dark brown sandstone ceiling/solid rock viewed from above with coarse cracks, full square; (15) quiet deep teal river water seamless top view; (16) pale sand windward slope surface viewed from above, diagonal softly curved broad ripple bands, no shadowed standalone dune.
Each is a reusable texture tile filling its ENTIRE square. This sheet will supply native editable modular terrain tiles, so no complete formations or terrain objects.
concepts: Whole-landform concepts were not imported: user required explorable 32px terrain. Native modular tiles and continuous tiled dunes are used.
